headline: Discussed revisions to library bylaws on communication, officer roles, financial report access, and social media and email accounts.
summary: Members worked on drafting language for the bylaws. Secretary Erica Laue will send a revised copy to members for review.
plain_text:
Leach Library Board of Trustees
Bylaws Subcommittee Draft Meeting minutes
August 26, 2026 at 6 PM
Sunnycrest Room, Town Hall, Londonderry NH
Members Present:
 Nancy Hendricks, Chair
 Erica Laue, Secretary
Call to Order: Called by Secretary Laue at 6:06 PM.
Public Comment: None.
Discussion:
 Particular phrasing around communication, the roles and permissions of Board officers, 
and community coordination.
 Discussion of clarification on “awareness of financial reports” and the access Trustees 
have to information.
 Crafted language regarding social media and email accounts.
Action Items:
 Secretary Laue will send the revised copy to the Board for review.
Public Comment: None.
Adjournment: 6:51 PM.
Minutes prepared by Secretary Laue.
